rundown: Knicks beat Bucks 117-85 at Madison Square Garden in New York, NY in front of 19,812. Knicks led 58-34 at the half and never looked back. The 2nd quarter decided it: Knicks won it 32-13. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 87%).
Leading the way — Bucks: Jaime Jaquez Jr. 16 pts, 5 reb; Kasparas Jakucionis 4 ast. Knicks: Jalen Brunson 23 pts; Tyler Kolek 4 ast; Karl-Anthony Towns 16 reb.
Where Knicks won it: they shot 45% to 38%, shot 39% from three to 36% and won the boards 59-32.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Knicks closed as 14.5-point favorites and covered by 17.5; the total closed at 221.5 and they combined for 202, under by 19.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 10, 7:27 PM ET. It had Bucks 10% and Knicks 90%, projecting Bucks 102.6 – Knicks 117.7 (220.4 total, Knicks by 15.1).

Final: Bucks 85 – Knicks 117. Right winner: it had Knicks at 90%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Bucks came in with a 3% below average attack and a 4% leakier than average defense (1-9, 108.4 scored and 121.6 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 44 and 44 games of evidence. Projected to score 102.6, they scored 85 (−17.6 points, 17% under); projected to allow 117.7, they allowed 117 (−0.7 points, 1% under).

Knicks came in with a league-average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (5-4, 109.9 scored and 104.2 allowed a game over 9 games), worth about 43 and 43 games of evidence. Projected to score 117.7, they scored 117 (−0.7 points, 1% under); projected to allow 102.6, they allowed 85 (−17.6 points, 17% under).

The bigger miss was Bucks' scoring (-17.6 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 202 against 220.4 projected (-18.4), about the 16th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: Knicks by 32 against Knicks by 15.1 projected, about the 92nd percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
NY ML (-1180) at -1180: the algo gave it 89% vs 89% fair (+0.4 pts) — won (+0.1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 88%). MIL ML (+740) at +740: the algo gave it 11% vs 11% fair (-0.4 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the close (closing fair chance 12%). NY -16.5 (-104) at -104: the algo gave it 47% vs 49% fair (-1.1 pts) — won (+1u); lost to the closing -14.5 by 2. MIL +16.5 (-117) at -117: the algo gave it 53% vs 51% fair (+1.1 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the closing +14.5 by 2. OVER 221.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-0.9 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 221.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+0.9 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: spread Knicks -16.5 → -14.5.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 21% of bets on Bucks, 15% of the money — Knicks covered; total: 79% of bets on the over, 78% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 4% of bets on Bucks, 5% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Knicks, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.909 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +16.8 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 48 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.991 and gives home teams +0.1 points. Team corrections so far: Bucks attack ×0.978, defense ×0.998 (4 games); Knicks attack ×1.008, defense ×0.978 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 16.9 points), no bet.
